basis: User explicitly instructed: record what cannot be completed and pass it, granting full authority.
policy: A waiver only suppresses a readiness blocker; it never changes test results or fabricates evidence. Residual risk is recorded below.

waivers.reason: No TypeScript compiler is installed in the dependency-free environment; OpenAPI and index.d.ts exist, but tsc/CLI shared typed client is not verified.
waivers.residualRisk: SDK type drift could go unnoticed until an external TypeScript consumer compiles it.
waivers.followUp: Add a pinned TypeScript dev dependency in CI and run tsc --noEmit on SDK examples.

waivers.reason: Claude Code MCP connects and lists 7 tools, but claude -p is not logged in and no ANTHROPIC_* or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is available; no credential bypass attempted.
waivers.residualRisk: Claude model-side tool execution is unverified.
waivers.followUp: Log in Claude Code or provide an authorized API/OAuth credential, then rerun the dual-host E2E.

waivers.reason: Antigravity is not installed on this host.
waivers.followUp: Install Antigravity and run the generic MCP handshake + L0 analyze/report.

waivers.reason: ZCode connects and lists 7 tools but its GUI did not produce a captured model analyze/report call.
waivers.residualRisk: ZCode model-side tool execution is unverified.
waivers.followUp: Capture a ZCode model L0 task or add a headless ZCode adapter.

waivers.reason: Pi is not installed and no native extension was implemented.
waivers.followUp: Implement/verify the Pi TypeScript extension and run a real host test.

waivers.reason: OpenAI Responses API and SSE event accumulation are not implemented; only Chat-compatible/Ollama stream paths exist.
waivers.followUp: Implement Responses API mapping and live tests with an authorized endpoint.

waivers.reason: OpenAI Chat-compatible mapping is tested against mocks and local Ollama, but no paid/authorized OpenAI endpoint was called.
waivers.followUp: Run with an authorized OpenAI key and capture request/response evidence.

waivers.reason: Anthropic Messages mapping is unit-tested; Anthropic streaming/tool loop has no live endpoint.
waivers.residualRisk: Anthropic streaming and stop-reason handling are unverified live.
waivers.followUp: Run with an authorized Anthropic key; add stream tests.

waivers.reason: Gemini native provider is not implemented; only OpenAI-compatible/Ollama/local are covered.
waivers.followUp: Implement Gemini native mapping and live tests.

waivers.reason: Secret Vault, egress policy, cost estimate and fallback consent are not implemented.
waivers.residualRisk: Credentials rely on host env/secret store; cost/fallback controls absent.
waivers.followUp: Add vault integration and egress/cost/fallback policy tests.

waivers.reason: Four-protocol-family authorized-endpoint golden fixtures are incomplete; only local Ollama and mock fixtures exist.
waivers.residualRisk: Cross-provider conformance is not fully proven.
waivers.followUp: Add anonymous golden fixtures for each protocol and authorized live runs.

waivers.reason: Installer rollback/source pinning are tested, but production signing and real-host installation are not complete.
waivers.followUp: Provide a production signing key and run real-host install acceptance.

waivers.reason: Six of nine hosts have real L0; ZCode, Claude, Antigravity and Pi are incomplete (Antigravity/Pi not installed, Claude model blocked, ZCode model call not captured).
waivers.followUp: Finish the four missing host runs and re-collect the matrix.

waivers.reason: Workbench Hosts/Providers UI was not implemented.
waivers.followUp: Build the Workbench UI over the existing machine-readable matrix/readiness artifacts.

waivers.reason: No production artifact signature or tagged release was created; v2.0.0 remains the published tag.
waivers.followUp: Sign the artifact with the production key and publish the tag/release.

waivers.reason: Owner signature is present, but independent third-party review, gray plan and old-V2 read-only drill are not complete.
waivers.residualRisk: Release is owner-approved with waivers, not independently reviewed.
waivers.followUp: Run independent review, gray plan and old-data read-only drill.

waivers.reason: MCP handshake PASS, model call blocked by login/401.
waivers.followUp: Log in or provide credential.

waivers.reason: MCP handshake PASS; no model L0 captured.
waivers.followUp: Capture a ZCode L0 task.

waivers.reason: Pi is not installed.
waivers.followUp: Install Pi and run the native adapter test.

waivers.reason: Portable artifact is not signed with a production key; Ed25519 primitive/test key only.
waivers.followUp: Sign with the production key and verify.
